title: Tom Brady wasn't a normal NFL player, and the Logan Paul 'feud' shows he isn't a normal team owner either

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tom Brady wasn't a normal NFL player, and the Logan Paul 'feud' shows he isn't a normal team owner either
sources.description: Brady seems insistent on being more than just a boring ex-quarterback who's happy to own part of an NFL team due to his name and legacy in football. So be it.
